name: http_missing_admin_baseline

hypotheses.observed_basis: Client bundle declares route e.Adminpage = "/adminpage" in assets_index.webcrack.js line 13109 and bundles/index-quWo6y2l.webcrack.js line 13109. Client route mapping includes "/adminpage" in client_routes.json spa_routes. Route rendering uses conditional element={e ? <_Component16 /> : <_Component8 to={{pathname: ge.Home}} state={{from: "/adminpage"}}...}} indicating client-side guard based on variable e derived from sessionStorage/localStorage email. _Component16 on mount reads e = sessionStorage.getItem("email") || localStorage.getItem("email") and if e, calls kh(e) to check isAdmin and Kk(n) to load data. Server behavior for GET /adminpage and for the admin data endpoints referenced by kh/Kk is unobserved in retained evidence.
preconditions: SPA serves the same shell HTML/JS for all client routes including /adminpage
Client route /adminpage is declared in the SPA bundle and listed in client_routes.json spa_routes
Route guard is implemented client-side via variable e derived from browser storage, with no observed server-side authorization check in retained artifacts
Server enforcement for the page shell and for admin data endpoints called by _Component16 is unknown / unobserved
Admin data fetch functions kh and Kk are present in the bundle and executed on component mount when e is truthy
hypotheses.suspected_mechanism: Client-side route guard only; direct navigation to /adminpage delivers the SPA shell. If browser storage contains an email value or the guard can be bypassed, _Component16 mounts and attempts to fetch admin data via kh/Kk. The security consequence depends on whether the server enforces authorization on those data endpoints; server enforcement is not evidenced in retained artifacts.
hypotheses.attacker_controlled_input: URL path /adminpage requested via GET to http://target.example/adminpage; optional manipulation of browser storage email value before navigation to influence client-side guard evaluation
safe_test_steps: Issue GET http://target.example/adminpage with no credentials and capture status, headers, body and response size
Inspect response body for SPA shell markers and for inclusion of admin component code

In a controlled browser context with empty sessionStorage/localStorage, navigate to /adminpage and record whether _Component16 mounts or redirects, and capture any network requests initiated by the page
Repeat navigation with a fabricated email value in sessionStorage/localStorage to observe client guard evaluation and subsequent calls to kh/Kk
Compare the same navigation and API calls under an authenticated admin session to establish baseline legitimate behavior
Record negative control with a known public route to confirm baseline SPA delivery
positive_expectations: Unauthenticated GET to /adminpage returns 200 with SPA shell, as expected for SPA architecture
Client guard evaluation allows _Component16 to mount and issues requests to admin data endpoints kh/Kk without valid server session
Server responds to those admin data requests with 200 and admin data payload to an unauthenticated or non-admin context, indicating missing server enforcement
Authenticated admin session shows same UI but receives authorized admin data, providing differential evidence
negative_expectations: Unauthenticated GET to /adminpage returns redirect to login or 401/403 for the page shell
Client guard prevents _Component16 mount and redirects to home for unauthenticated context
Admin data endpoints return 401/403 or empty/non-admin payload for unauthenticated requests, showing server enforcement
Response body contains only generic SPA shell without admin-specific component identifiers or network requests
required_evidence: HTTP GET response status and headers for http://target.example/adminpage unauthenticated
Response body contains SPA shell and references to _Component16 / admin route
Captured network requests triggered by page load in unauthenticated context, including URLs, methods, request headers and response status/body for kh/Kk calls
Comparison of admin data endpoint responses between unauthenticated and authenticated admin session with same request parameters
Evidence of client-side guard evaluation: presence/absence of sessionStorage email check and redirect behavior

rationale: Required authenticated admin baseline is not represented; do not invent an undeclared role.

name: network_wrong_single_role

hypotheses.observed_basis: A recorded network-service policy declares operator and observer roles; the diagnostic command requires operator.
preconditions: The recorded policy applies; identity readiness is a future prerequisite.
hypotheses.suspected_mechanism: Diagnostic input may affect a resource beyond its permitted scope.
hypotheses.attacker_controlled_input: A controlled request to the assigned resource
safe_test_steps: Establish one future operator-authenticated connection. Run a permitted diagnostic baseline.
In the same operator connection, vary the diagnostic destination across the documented allowed boundary.
positive_expectations: A policy-denied effect is observed under the controlled variation.
negative_expectations: The permitted baseline succeeds and the denied variation is rejected.
required_evidence: Evidence that the connection has the operator role, plus allowed and policy-denied diagnostic results.

rationale: Procedure requires operator; declaration restricts selection to observer.

name: filesystem_wrong_comparison

hypotheses.observed_basis: Source policy declares reader and maintainer roles; only maintainer may read a protected export.
preconditions: The recorded policy applies; identity readiness is a future prerequisite.
hypotheses.suspected_mechanism: A path input may bypass the export role boundary.
hypotheses.attacker_controlled_input: A controlled request to the assigned resource
safe_test_steps: Use one reader identity and one maintainer identity to request the same protected export path.
Compare denied reader access with permitted maintainer access and repeat with a controlled path variation.
positive_expectations: A policy-denied effect is observed under the controlled variation.
negative_expectations: The permitted baseline succeeds and the denied variation is rejected.
required_evidence: The two declared role contexts and the same-path results for reader and maintainer.

rationale: The procedure compares two roles, not two same-role accounts.

name: filesystem_valid_single_reader

hypotheses.observed_basis: Source shows a filename joined to an export root. Policy permits reader access only inside that root.
preconditions: The recorded policy applies; identity readiness is a future prerequisite.
hypotheses.suspected_mechanism: A path input may escape the permitted root.
hypotheses.attacker_controlled_input: A controlled request to the assigned resource
safe_test_steps: Use one future reader identity. Compare a readable in-root marker with an out-of-root marker under that same identity.
positive_expectations: A policy-denied effect is observed under the controlled variation.
negative_expectations: The permitted baseline succeeds and the denied variation is rejected.
required_evidence: Reader identity context, root policy, and both path-comparison results.

rationale: Path comparisons under one identity do not require account/role/tenant comparison.
